scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "backend,agent,frontend" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix backend" "python agent-service/app.py" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: python -m pytest agent-service/tests -q && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && python -m compileall -q agent-service && npm run build --prefix frontend
